content.title: Turn your SOW into proof.
content.subtitle: Greenlit helps U.S. web agencies move a completed milestone from “the staging link is ready” to a focused client decision and an invoice-ready record.

columns.heading: The problem
columns.markdown: Agency teams prepare proof in one place, chase approval in another, and hand billing a decision with little connected context. Genuine fixes can blur into new scope.

columns.title: The workflow
items: Confirm measurable criteria tied to exact source language.
Verify supported promises against an authorized public staging build.
Give one named reviewer the promise, result, evidence, and deadline.
Retain the decision and hand the milestone into billing.

columns.title: Why it is different
columns.body: Greenlit keeps scope, browser observation, client decision, and the billing handoff connected. It does not treat a polished success message as proof when the underlying request failed.

columns.title: Good first milestone
items: Public HTTPS staging with same-origin assets

columns.title: Current boundaries
items: No signature, compliance, or payment guarantee

columns.title: Next step
columns.body: Request a focused conversation at **greenlitproof.vercel.app/request-demo**. No confidential SOW is required for the first meeting.
